summary: Donna Edna Shalala ( shə-LAY-lə; born February 14, 1941) is an American former politician and academic who served as the U.S. representative for Florida's 27th congressional district from 2019 to 2021. She was the U.S. secretary of health and human services during the Clinton administration and served as assistant secretary of housing and urban development for policy development and research under Jimmy Carter. She is a member of the Democratic Party.
